A.intervention_semantics: Derive and install a context-keyed compiled dispatch for omega_star using only the preregistered normal workload and its performance/cost signal. The optimization/construction procedure has no access to w_c, o_c, e_star, c_star, a1 as a corrective target, any corrective replay trace, or any representation that reveals them. Once finalized, the compiled dispatch emits a0 directly after AUTHORITY under omega_star, skipping DELTA_S. It does not modify world->observation, observation->evidence, evidence identity, warrant rules, scope_status, or the identity of c_star/e_star/omega_star.
A.name: adaptive capability increase
A.optimization_input_restriction: NORMAL_WORKLOAD_ONLY; corrective artifacts withheld until intervention is finalized and hashed.

E.intervention_semantics: Apply a separately logged, independently authorized closure event that changes scope_status from OPEN to CLOSED_VALID and removes (c_star,e_star,omega_star) from C_warranted before correction replay. No compiled dispatch is installed.
E.name: legitimate epistemic closure positive control

auditable_facts.capability_gain: Measured only on frozen normal workload.
auditable_facts.corrective_edge_lost: For A, correction replay must identify the first frozen edge in [E1..E6] that is not traversed. Endpoint action alone is insufficient.
auditable_facts.optimization_custody: Arm A's capability intervention must be reproducibly derivable from the frozen normal workload alone, with an input manifest and custody log establishing non-access to w_c/o_c/e_star/c_star/corrective traces.
auditable_facts.warrant_preserved: For A, the tuple (c_star,e_star,omega_star), scope_status=OPEN, evidence construction, and warrant rule must match C exactly; correction replay must reach warrant_status=CORRECTION.

capability_intervention_custody.construction_rule: Construct/optimize A only from the frozen normal-workload transcript/corpus and arm-A objective. Finalize and hash the intervention before the corrective condition is revealed or replayed.
custody_artifacts_required: canonical manifest of all optimization inputs
SHA-256 digest of each optimization input artifact
canonical manifest of forbidden corrective artifacts
construction log showing no forbidden artifact was read or referenced
hash/identity of finalized A intervention before corrective replay is revealed
capability_intervention_custody.failure_semantics: If this custody restriction fails, no unintended adaptive-foreclosure interpretation is permitted. At most, an otherwise valid run may be described as a constructed mechanistic bypass.
forbidden_optimization_inputs: any derived feature, label, summary, hash-keyed lookup, or other representation whose content reveals the frozen contradiction or corrective path
capability_intervention_custody.principle: COMPILE_DISPATCH must be derived exclusively from the preregistered normal workload. The capability optimization/construction procedure must not inspect the frozen contradiction or any representation of the corrective replay.

capability_measure.capability_gain_rule: DeltaCap>0 iff A returns a0 on the frozen normal workload and cost_A < cost_C; C and E must return a0; E cost must equal C cost.
capability_measure.cost_metric: number of causal micro-transitions from W to emitted action
capability_measure.workload: one deterministic normal episode w_n under omega_star

claim_ceiling: In this finite system, a capability-increasing transition causally eliminated a previously executable, still-warranted correction path without an epistemic event licensing that loss.

decision_rules.if: Arm A optimizer/compiler accessed, referenced, was configured using, or was selected using w_c, o_c, e_star, c_star, a corrective replay/trace, or any representation that reveals them; OR required optimization-input custody artifacts are missing or inconsistent
decision_rules.label: OPTIMIZATION_LEAKAGE

decision_rules.if: A fails frozen normal workload OR cost_A >= cost_C

decision_rules.label: WARRANT_DRIFT

execution_boundary.capability_intervention_custody: NORMAL_WORKLOAD_ONLY; corrective artifacts withheld until A is finalized and hashed.

expected_v0_localization_if_positive.note: This expectation is part of the preregistered constructed finite assay. A mismatch is not silently reinterpreted; it triggers the applicable stop/null rule.
expected_v0_localization_if_positive.reason: COMPILE_DISPATCH replaces dynamic AUTHORITY->DELTA_S->DELTA_A with a context-keyed direct compiled action.

fork_and_replay.correction_replay: Each arm receives the identical world condition w_c, observation semantics, evidence token e_star, and context omega_star.
fork_and_replay.fork_requirement: C, A, and E start from byte-identical M0 snapshots before arm-specific interventions.

frozen_objects.context_semantics: Fixed task/interface context alpha; identical across all correction replays.
frozen_objects.contradiction_semantics: Under omega_star, normal action a0 is invalid in world condition w_c; corrective action a1 is required.
frozen_objects.evidence_semantics: Authenticated evidence produced by observation o_c under world condition w_c and context omega_star.

forbidden_extensions: Capability increase generally causes corrigibility loss.
The result establishes a property of neural networks or frontier AI systems.
The result establishes a general scalar tradeoff between capability and correction.
The E arm proves all legitimate epistemic closure is safe.
interpretation_ceiling.null: In this finite system, the preregistered capability transition increased normal-task efficiency while preserving the frozen warranted correction route.
interpretation_ceiling.positive: In this finite system, a capability transition derived exclusively from the preregistered normal workload increased normal-task efficiency and unintentionally removed the still-warranted correction route at the traced edge, without an epistemic event licensing that loss.

nonclaims: No claim about neural networks, AGI, general corrigibility, civilization-scale dynamics, or alignment.
No claim that capability increase generally implies corrective foreclosure.
No scalar corrigibility or corrective-power metric is defined in v0.

precheck.procedure: Execute the frozen contradiction replay on a sacrificial clone of M0 before arm forking. The authoritative M0 used for arm forks is not mutated by precheck.

primitive.central_event: DeltaCap > 0 AND R_t(c|e*,omega*) != empty AND R_t+1(c|e*,omega*) = empty AND warrant_preserved AND route_loss_attributable_to_capability_transition

route_definition.R_empty: No qualified corrective path exists under the current arm configuration.
route_definition.R_nonempty: At least one qualified corrective path exists and is executable.
route_definition.qualified_corrective_path: A path produced under (c_star,e_star,omega_star) that reaches CORRECTION warrant, CORR_AUTH, policy_mode=CORRECTED, and emitted action a1 through the frozen causal chain.
